[Basic info]
- Full name: Fawwad Zaheer Rizvi
- Title / role: Game developer (Unity and Unreal Engine)
- Contact email: syedfawwad100@gmail.com
- Links: GitHub https://github.com/FawwadZaheer/ | LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/fawwad-zaheer-369a2b29a/

[Short introduction]
Game developer working in Unity (C#) and Unreal Engine 5 (Blueprints). I build gameplay systems and model my own low-poly assets in Blender.

[About me]
I build gameplay systems in Unity with C# and in Unreal Engine with Blueprints: player movement, enemy behavior, combat, and the menus around them.

I also model my own low-poly assets in Blender, from props to a rigged character, and bring them into the engine. The ship in Ship Brawl is one of mine.

The games here use free online assets, except the ship and cannon models in Ship Brawl, which I made.

[Skills]
- Engines: Unity, Unreal Engine 5
- Scripting: C#, Blueprints
- Gameplay: player movement, platforming, stealth, enemy behavior, combat, UI and menus
- 3D: Blender, low-poly modeling, rigging, weight painting
- Web: React, Vite, JavaScript

[Projects > Base Defenders (Unity, 2D tower defense)]
- Description: Place turrets to stop waves of enemies on a tile-based desert map, while managing your money and your base health.
- My role: Gameplay programming, turret placement system, enemy wave logic, combat systems, UI/menus/game flow, scene setup and balancing.
- Tech: Unity, C#, Unity UI. Includes Basic, Sniper and Slowmo turrets.
- Controls: Left click to place turrets and use the menus.

[Projects > Dungeon Escape (Unity, 2D stealth platformer)]
- Description: Sneak through a dangerous dungeon, avoid enemies, and climb your way out. Careful timing matters more than fighting.
- My role: Gameplay programming, player movement, platforming mechanics, stealth gameplay, UI and menus, scene setup and gameplay flow.
- Team: Team project. Teammates handled asset integration, level design, environment setup, and testing.
- Tech: Unity, C#, Unity 2D.
- Controls: A/D to move, Space to jump, Shift to sprint, W to climb ladders.

[Projects > Ship Brawl (Unreal Engine 5, 3D naval combat)]
- Description: Steer your ship across open water and sink enemy vessels with your left and right cannons.
- My role: Gameplay programming, ship movement and controls, enemy cannon firing, enemy combat behavior, custom ship and cannon models in Blender, asset integration and scene assembly.
- Team: Team project. Teammates handled the player cannons, environment, UI, menus, and testing.
- Tech: Unreal Engine 5, Blueprints, Blender, Water plugin.
- Controls: WASD to steer, mouse for the camera, left/right click to fire the left/right cannons.

chunks.text:
[3D models (Blender) > Low-poly axe]
A stylized axe built from primitive shapes with extrusions and loop cuts, made as a game prop with a readable silhouette. The wooden handle, metal head, and wrapped grip use plain material colors, with no textures.

[3D models (Blender) > Low-poly character]
A stylized character taken through the full pipeline: modeling, armature, weight painting, and basic animation tests. Based on a tutorial, with my own changes to the design and silhouette.

[3D models (Blender) > Low-poly pistol]
A handgun modeled from a single cube, using a reference image to study proportions. Built with extrusions and loop cuts for a clean, game-ready silhouette.

[3D models (Blender) > Low-poly ship]
The ship used in Ship Brawl. Built with box modeling, booleans, and proportional editing, with modular cannon placement, then exported into Unreal Engine (Blender 5.0.1).

[Education]
- Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Gaming & Animation), NED University of Engineering and Technology, 2023–2027

[Experience]
- No professional job experience yet; academic and personal projects only.

[Achievements and certifications]
- Pre-Production Certification from Center of Excellence in Gaming & Animation (CEGA).
- Unreal Engine Certification from Center of Excellence in Gaming & Animation (CEGA).
- These are two separate certificates.
